findings.title: Q3 citability status remains unpropagated to current authorities and gate
evidence: cite: Gate 11 / R-STA-002
source: JUDGMENT
finding_class: HARD

RESULTS_INDEX.md:38-44 declares Q3 STATUS: CITABLE, demotion CLOSED, and admissible condition-3 gate evidence; Q0_POLARON_EXCLUDED.md:1-9, Q0_RESOLVED.md:1-8, and P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md:1-8 still assert that Q3 is UNVERIFIED/NOT CITABLE or that citability awaits the next independent audit, without a historical/superseded marker.

Q0_NEB_GATE.md:10 and :73-75 simultaneously mark condition 3 PASS and state that independent re-verification is pending/owed before the demotion is lifted. The submitted F-019 propagation fix 1cca3f648c25af1fc22a98a11d4319fa488aa4eb is not an ancestor of the fixed commit.
The Q3 raw derivation itself succeeds at this snapshot; the defect is incompatible current status/provenance assertions, not a re-verdict of the raw result.

reproduce: rg -n 'STATUS: CITABLE|UNVERIFIED.?/?NOT CITABLE|Citability is restored only|Pending independent re-verification|independent re-verification is owed' RESULTS_INDEX.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_POLARON_EXCLUDED.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_RESOLVED.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_NEB_GATE.md; git merge-base --is-ancestor 1cca3f648c25af1fc22a98a11d4319fa488aa4eb HEAD; printf 'fix_ancestor_rc=%s\n' "$?"

proposed_check: C-STATE-006 — parse the canonical Q3 block, every authority path it declares, and Q0 gate condition 3; fail when current CITABLE/closed/PASS predicates coexist with UNVERIFIED, NOT-CITABLE, pending-reverification, or re-verification-owed text outside an explicit historical/superseded/retracted context. A fixture with this snapshot's index plus any authority banner or gate wording must fail; marking the retained wording historical must pass.

findings.title: q=+1 staging record conflicts with the current production-run provenance state
evidence: cite: Gate 11 / R-STA-002
source: JUDGMENT
finding_class: HARD

ehpc/inputs_stage2/neb_q1_production/staging_manifest.json:3 records submission_status BLOCKED_DO_NOT_SUBMIT; :24 says it was never a real staging operation and its q1 endpoint input never existed, without a historical/superseded marker.

PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md:1-12 instead asserts BOTH LEGS CONVERGED and a production q=+1 run, while :27-28 says q1/q1_initial_relaxed.extxyz and q1/q1_final_relaxed.extxyz are now committed and close the F-003 input-source gap. The named q1 initial structure exists and hashes to the same 7af20e… value the staging record associates with q0.
These documents assert incompatible current states for the required q=+1 staging/input custody; this audit does not decide which account is correct.

reproduce: rg -n 'BLOCKED_DO_NOT_SUBMIT|not describe a real staging|never existed|BOTH LEGS CONVERGED|closes the F-003' ehpc/inputs_stage2/neb_q1_production/staging_manifest.json results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md; test -f results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/q1/q1_initial_relaxed.extxyz && shasum -a 256 results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/q1/q1_initial_relaxed.extxyz

proposed_check: C-STATE-007 — for every current production-run authority, resolve its named staging manifest and input paths; fail if an unmarked manifest says BLOCKED_DO_NOT_SUBMIT, never staged, or missing input while the authority asserts the run completed, or if a stated absent path exists in the audited tree. Fixture: retain this q1 manifest with the current production-status file.

findings.title: Canonical index omits the live XRD passivator-screen conclusions
evidence: cite: Gate 11 / R-NAV-001
source: JUDGMENT
finding_class: HARD

RESULTS_INDEX.md:1-4 declares itself the index of every scientific question and current answer. Its only XRD entry (:99-102) identifies xrd/ as an independent sub-project and points to xrd/README.md, with no question, conclusion, raw-data locator, or pointer to the six-film analysis.

xrd/PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md:1-22 and :66-148 is an unmarked current six-film result with VALID/PROVISIONAL/NOT COMPARABLE dispositions and conclusions including P5 ~10% PbI2 (3.8x control) and P3 below detection. Neither RESULTS_INDEX.md nor xrd/README.md references PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md or the P1-P5/Generations-0726 result.
The canonical index therefore does not carry this live conclusion or direct a reader to its authority, even though the tracked result is current rather than archived or superseded.
reproduce: rg -n 'PASSIVATOR_SCREEN|P5|P3|Generations-0726' RESULTS_INDEX.md xrd/README.md xrd/PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md; sed -n '99,102p' RESULTS_INDEX.md; sed -n '1,22p;66,148p' xrd/PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md

proposed_check: C-NAV-005 — require RESULTS_INDEX.md to contain one explicit current XRD/passivator row when an unmarked xrd/PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md exists; the row must name that authority and raw/results paths. Fixture: an index containing only the present generic xrd/ README pointer with PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md retained must fail.
